rule.name: EqualsLeavesOutField
rule.message: This field is set by the constructor and returned by a getter, but neither equals nor hashCode reads it, while both compare the other fields of the class. Two objects that differ only in this field are equal, so a set or map keeps the wrong one. Add it to both methods: Objects.equals(extension, that.extension) and Objects.hash(groupId, artifactId, extension). An exception fits when the field is not part of the identity of the value: mark it transient or name it as a cache, lock or listener.
